articles.title: Lionel Messi's animated show shows its first teaser
articles.summary: Messi and the Giants, an animated Disney series with soccer star Lionel Messi as an executive producer, revealed its first teaser at Comic-Con Málaga. It follows a 12-year-old boy trapped in a world ruled by giants.

articles.title: Engineers build a robot hand that walks like Thing
articles.summary: Swiss engineers built a robot hand that can balance on its fingertips, walk across grass and gravel, and even type. It was inspired by Thing from The Addams Family.

articles.title: A fabric called Plant Armor helps strawberries grow more
articles.summary: A new fabric called Plant Armor helped strawberry plants produce more than three times as much fruit in tunnel tests. It keeps insects away while letting in sunlight, rain and air.
